name: Toggle
description: Converts a monostable pulse input into a bi-stable toggle output. Each rising edge on the input toggles the output state.

inputs.name: Input
inputs.description: Pulse input signal. On each rising edge (false to true transition), the output will toggle its state.

outputs.name: Output
outputs.description: Bi-stable output that toggles its state on each input pulse.

state.name: Last input state
state.description: Stores the previous state of the input to detect rising edges
